"""Conditional iid-Gaussian local predictor, tested against cached native pilot crops."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import numpy as np

from analysis.render import runtime_env
from measure_noise_opening_stages import read_crops,paired_covariance
from study_noise_neighbourhoods import ROOT,sha256,git


def conditional_variance(mean,black,slope,dark_variance):
    if not np.isfinite([mean,black,slope,dark_variance]).all() or slope<0 or dark_variance<=0:
        raise ValueError('Finite mean, nonnegative slope and positive dark variance required')
    signal=mean-black
    return dict(signed_signal_dn=signal,nonnegative_signal_dn=max(signal,0.),variance_dn2=dark_variance+slope*max(signal,0.))


def compare(prediction,observed):
    prediction=np.asarray(prediction,dtype=float);observed=np.asarray(observed,dtype=float)
    if prediction.shape!=(3,3) or observed.shape!=(3,3) or not np.isfinite(prediction).all() or not np.isfinite(observed).all() or np.min(np.diag(observed))<=0 or np.min(np.diag(prediction))<0:
        raise ValueError('Finite3x3 covariances with positive observed diagonal required')
    return dict(predicted_covariance=prediction.tolist(),observed_covariance=observed.tolist(),
        sigma_ratios=np.sqrt(np.diag(prediction)/np.diag(observed)).tolist(),
        relative_frobenius_error=float(np.linalg.norm(prediction-observed)/np.linalg.norm(observed)))


def run():
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc);folder=ROOT/'docs/validation/raw'
    names=('sonde-etapes-ouverture-bruit-v001-20261028T104746Z.json',
        'qualification-noirs-repetes-bruit-v001-20261028T100350Z.json',
        'qualification-rafales-carte-bruit-v001-20261028T094754Z.json',
        'loi-variance-noir-fige-bruit-v001-20261028T101443Z.json')
    paths=[folder/n for n in names];hashes=[sha256(p) for p in paths]
    pilot,blacks,scenes,law=[json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in paths]
    refs={(g['iso'],r['roi'],r['plane']):r for g in blacks['records'] for r in g['measurements']}
    slopes={(r['iso'],r['plane']):r['model']['nonnegative_slope_dn'] for r in law['records']}
    manifest_path=ROOT/'config/raw-normalization.json';manifest_hash=sha256(manifest_path)
    manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    tool=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/burst-tools/Release/iprLocalNoiseTransport.exe';tool_hash=sha256(tool)
    subprocess.run([str(tool),'--self-test'],check=True,env=runtime_env(tool),timeout=30)
    cases=[];native_pixels={}
    for pi,pair in enumerate(pilot['records']):
        iso=pair['iso'];first=pair['paths'][0];record=pilot['native'][first]['record'];state=record['pre_interpolate_state']
        profile=Path(record['profile'])
        if sha256(profile)!=record['profile_sha256']:raise ValueError('Source profile changed')
        entries=[e for e in manifest['entries'] if e['profile_sha256']==record['profile_sha256'] and e['white_level']==record['white_before_process']]
        if len(entries)!=1 or not record['calibration_applied']:raise ValueError('Cannot reconstruct calibrated DCP context uniquely')
        compensation=[r for r in manifest.get('profile_rendering',[]) if r['profile_sha256']==record['profile_sha256']]
        if len(compensation)>1:raise ValueError('Ambiguous profile compensation')
        for source in pair['paths']:
            item=pilot['native'][source]
            if sha256(Path(item['pixels']['path']))!=item['pixels']['sha256']:raise ValueError('Native pixels changed')
            native_pixels[source]=read_crops(Path(item['pixels']['path']),item['record'])
        for roi in range(3):
            means=[];variances=[];conditions=[]
            for plane in ('R','G1','G2','B'):
                ref=refs[(iso,roi,plane)]
                if pair['role']=='black':
                    index=next(i for i,f in enumerate(next(g for g in blacks['records'] if g['iso']==iso)['decoded_frames']) if Path(f['path']).stem==Path(first).stem)
                    mean=ref['all_frames']['frame_means_dn'][index]
                else:
                    g=next(g for g in scenes['records'] if g['paths'][0]==first)
                    mean=next(r for r in g['planes'] if r['roi']==roi and r['plane']==plane)['frame_means_dn'][0]
                condition=conditional_variance(mean,ref['development_black_dn'],slopes[(iso,plane)],ref['development']['centered_temporal_variance_dn2'])
                means.append(mean);variances.append(condition['variance_dn2']);conditions.append(condition)
            cases.append(dict(case_id=f'{pi}-{roi}',pair_index=pi,roi=roi,iso=iso,role=pair['role'],
                mean_raw_dn=means,raw_variance_dn2=variances,conditional_law=conditions,
                applied_black_dn=record['applied_black_dn'],pre_mul=state['pre_mul'],maximum=state['maximum'],
                profile=record['profile'],profile_sha256=record['profile_sha256'],source_kelvin=record['source_kelvin'],
                baseline_exposure_ev=entries[0]['baseline_exposure_ev'],
                profile_exposure_compensation_ev=compensation[0]['exposure_compensation_ev'] if compensation else 0.,
                preserve_tone_curve_hue=True,seed=28102026+pi*3+roi))
    stamp=started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ');work=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/local-noise-transport'/stamp
    work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    request=dict(trials=32,cases=cases,policy='Uniform latent512 CFA tile per case; mean from first source only, frozen same-ISO phase slopes and development dark. Independent Gaussian raw perturbations, raw14bit rounding, actual black subtraction/lower clip and effective gain/uint16 quantization, exact production RCD+OpeningMedian, center128 and actual DCP. No parameter fitted to native output covariance.')
    request_path=folder/f'gel-prediction-locale-bruit-v001-{stamp}.json'
    with request_path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:json.dump(request,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('FROZEN',request_path,flush=True)
    out=work/'native.json'
    subprocess.run([str(tool),str(request_path),str(out)],check=True,env=runtime_env(tool),timeout=1500)
    native=json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));by_id={r['case_id']:r for r in native['records']}
    projection=np.array([[.2627002120112671,.6779980715188708,.0593017164698620],[1,0,-1],[-.5,1,-.5]])
    results=[]
    for case in cases:
        pred=by_id[case['case_id']];pair=pilot['records'][case['pair_index']];roi=case['roi']
        a,b=[native_pixels[p] for p in pair['paths']]
        observed_camera=paired_covariance(a['post_rcd_median_camera_rgb'][roi][64:192,64:192],b['post_rcd_median_camera_rgb'][roi][64:192,64:192])
        observed_working=paired_covariance(a['post_dcp_rec2020'][roi][64:192,64:192],b['post_dcp_rec2020'][roi][64:192,64:192])
        working=np.asarray(pred['covariance_working'])
        result=dict(case_id=case['case_id'],iso=case['iso'],role=case['role'],roi=roi,
            camera=compare(pred['covariance_camera'],observed_camera),working=compare(working,observed_working),
            y_co_cg=compare(projection@working@projection.T,projection@observed_working@projection.T),
            simulation_half_check=compare(pred['first_half_working'],pred['second_half_working']),
            simulated_zero_fractions=pred['pre_rcd_zero_fractions'])
        results.append(result);print(case['case_id'],case['iso'],case['role'],'sigma Y/Co/Cg',np.round(result['y_co_cg']['sigma_ratios'],3).tolist(),flush=True)
    if tool_hash!=sha256(tool) or hashes!=[sha256(p) for p in paths] or manifest_hash!=sha256(manifest_path):raise ValueError('Parent/tool/config changed')
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc);output=folder/f'prediction-locale-transport-bruit-v001-{now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
    result=dict(campaign_id='noise-local-transport-'+stamp,schema_version=1,data_version=1,
        started_at_utc=started.isoformat(),measured_at_utc=now.isoformat(),completed_at_utc=now.isoformat(),
        parents=[dict(path=str(p),sha256=h) for p,h in zip(paths,hashes)],
        request=dict(path=str(request_path),sha256=sha256(request_path)),native=dict(path=str(out),sha256=sha256(out)),
        tool=dict(path=str(tool),sha256=tool_hash),manifest=dict(path=str(manifest_path),sha256=manifest_hash),
        records=results,commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),runner_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)),runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
        sources={n:dict(sha256=sha256(ROOT/n),source=(ROOT/n).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for n in (
            'tests/burst_tools/local_noise_transport.cpp','src/raw/Demosaic.cpp','src/profiles/CameraProfileEngine.cpp')},
        units='Normalized camera/Rec2020 covariance; dimensionless predicted/observed sigma ratios.',
        limitations='First mono-source mean predictor but phase slopes/darks and photos already inspected; no held-out quality claim. Gaussian iid RAW is a control, not real correlated CFA noise. Uniform512 tile cannot reproduce scene structure/global tile median weights. Phase latent means themselves noisy; no attempt to invert censored data. Simulated per-pixel temporal covariance removes ensemble bias; observed two-frame spatial covariance may contain motion/global WB/black differences. Remaining LibRaw operations after RCD callback not simulated before DCP. Center128 and current CameraNeutral calibrated/no optics only. No production change, visual denoise improvement claim, new RAW decode or final sealed burst access.',
        verdict='conditional_iid_local_transport_feasibility_not_validated_noise_predictor')
    with output.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:json.dump(result,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('RESULT',output,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':run()
